title: AutoCraftmod
description: AutoCraft is a simple client-side that allows players to craft items automatically using a convenient menu and customizable keybind
body:
# AutoCraft
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/691e43ddf15fbceb017e4f3e5bc410bac35ad4a3.png)
AutoCraft is a lightweight crafting helper for **Minecraft 1.16.5** on **Forge**.

It lets you browse available crafting recipes, pick how many times you want to craft them, and craft directly from your **inventory (2x2)** or a **crafting table (3x3)**.

The mod is built around the normal container flow, so it feels close to vanilla and is much easier to use in everyday survival gameplay.

## Features

- Browse recipes from the current crafting grid
- Works in the **player inventory** for 2x2 recipes
- Works in the **crafting table** for full 3x3 recipes
- Search recipes by item name or recipe id
- Set craft amount manually
- Quick amount buttons: `x1`, `x16`, `x64`
- `All` mode to craft as much as possible
- Repeat the last recipe quickly
- Keyboard-friendly navigation
- Optional recipe blocking to hide recipes you do not want to use

## Controls

- `R` opens the AutoCraft menu
- `Shift + R` repeats the last recipe
- `Enter` crafts the currently selected recipe
- Mouse wheel or arrow keys switch between recipes
- Right-click on a recipe blocks or unblocks it

## How To Use

1. Open your inventory or a crafting table
2. Press `R` or click the `AutoCraft` button
3. Search for the recipe you want
4. Pick the amount or enable `All`
5. Press `Enter`, click the recipe, or use the `Craft` button

## Why Use AutoCraft

- Faster than manual recipe placement
- Useful for repetitive crafting sessions
- Keeps recipe browsing simple and clean
- Helps when you want to craft large batches quickly
- Still works through normal crafting interactions instead of adding a separate fake crafting system

## Compatibility

- Minecraft `1.16.5 forg


The mod is intended for **client-side use** and is designed to work through normal crafting container actions for better singleplayer and multiplayer compatibility.

## Notes

- Recipes shown depend on the crafting grid you currently have open
- 2x2-only menu usage works from the player inventory
- 3x3 recipes require a crafting table
- Some heavily customized servers or modpacks may affect crafting behavior.
